title: Setting Change Fees Already Paid against a No-Show Penalty on the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Change fees a traveller has already paid on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking may be set against the gross no-show penalty raised on that booking. What is set off is decided by how many voluntary change lines the booking carries over a window of 12 months, measured against the ceiling on voluntary changes scheduled for the fare brand held.

## 1. The allowance

1.1 Where the booking carries voluntary change lines posted in the last 12 months numbering at least the brand's ceiling on voluntary changes, the change fees posted in that period are taken off in full.

1.2 Where the booking carries at least 1 such line posted in the last 12 months and fewer than the brand's ceiling on voluntary changes, 0.5 of those change fees — 50 percent of them — is taken off.

1.3 In every other case no such allowance is taken off.

Both the count of lines and the fees summed are taken over the same window: the voluntary change lines posted to the booking in the last 12 months.

## 2. The brand ceilings the count is read against

| Fare brand | Ceiling on voluntary changes |
| --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 |
| Economy Saver | 1 |
| Economy Classic | 2 |
| Economy Flex | 4 |
| Premium Economy Select | 4 |
| Business Saver | 6 |
| Business Flex | 12 |

## 3. Input, judgement and outcome, on hypothetical figures

**Input.** An Economy Classic booking carrying 2 voluntary change lines posted in the last 12 months, of 149.00 and 149.00 USD.
**Judgement.** The brand's ceiling is 2; the booking carries 2 such lines, which is at least the ceiling.
**Outcome.** The change fees posted in that period, 298.00 USD, are taken off in full.

**Input.** The same booking carrying 1 such line of 149.00 USD.
**Judgement.** The booking carries at least 1 line and fewer than the ceiling of 2.
**Outcome.** 50 percent of 149.00 USD, being 74.50 USD, is taken off.

**Input.** The same booking carrying no voluntary change line inside the window, though one stands 14 months back.
**Judgement.** Neither of the first two conditions is met, the older line falling outside the 12-month window.
**Outcome.** No such allowance is taken off.
